Secondly, in order to reinforce the reliabilities of multiphase machine, the HFSI sensorless control is employed. Comparing with traditional HFSI method, the proposed control strategy is achieved in 5th harmonic subspace, which can avoid the torque ripple caused by the injected signal. Finally, according to simulations results the two torque distribution method is validated and compared and the effectiveness of the HFSI method is verified.

articleTitle: The High Efficiency Control Method of PMSMs Based on Gradient Descent Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th Student Conference on Electric Machines and Systems (SCEMS)
abstract: Maximum efficiency per ampere(MEPA) strategy based on loss model of motor is the commonly used high efficient control algorithm for permanent magnet synchronous motors. It takes into account the minimization of copper loss and iron loss, so the efficiency is higher than that of maximum torque per ampere(MTPA) strategy. In order to solve the problem that the process is too complicated when the MEPA strategy is used to obtain the optimal current, the gradient descent algorithm is introduced, and the simulation results show that it has a good effect.

articleTitle: A Novel Hybrid Excited Machine with DC Bias and Magnetic- Saturati on - Alleviati on
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th Student Conference on Electric Machines and Systems (SCEMS)
abstract: Nowadays, hybrid excited machines (HEM) are widely utilized due to their high power density and goog field adjustment ability. However, they usually need extra slip rings and brushes, which result in complex structures, lower the robustness, and increase the maintenance. This paper presents a novel hybrid excited machine structure. Biased DC in the armature winding is used to adjust the magnetization field. To alleviate the magnetic saturation in the stator core caused by hybrid excitation, auxiliary PMs are added in the slot opening. The finite element analysis result shows that the magnetic-saturation-alleviation structure can effectively improve the performance of the machine.

articleTitle: Simplified Analysis of the Influence Scope of DC Magnetic Bias
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th Student Conference on Electric Machines and Systems (SCEMS)
abstract: High voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission operating under monopole ground return mode causes a change in the surrounding ground potential, which leads to DC magnetic bias in the transformers. This paper proposes a simplified method for analyzing the influence scope of DC magnetic bias, with ensuring the accuracy of the results and improving the efficiency of the simulation modelling calculation. The simplified method is based on considering a unit distance potential difference less than the modelling threshold. The whole power system in Zhejiang Province, considering 220 kV and 500 kV substations, is modeled and studied with PSCAD simulator. The modeling range can be simplified to 50 km with 2000 A current injection at the grounding electrode in Jinhua. The simulation results of the whole Zhejiang power system and the simplified system validate the proposed simplified method, and the error of DC current at the neutral point of the nearby substation is within 2%.

articleTitle: MPPT Control Strategy of Variable Speed Hydropower System Based on Improved Fuzzy Control
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th Student Conference on Electric Machines and Systems (SCEMS)
abstract: Variable speed constant frequency (VSCF) hydropower system tracks the maximum power of hydraulic turbine through variable speed operation to improve the power generation efficiency of hydraulic turbine. It has attracted extensive attention in the field of renewable energy. This paper presents a new fuzzy maximum power point tracking (MPPT) control strategy based on starting speed. Through the analysis of hydraulic turbine speed efficiency model, the starting speed fuzzy controller and fuzzy control MPPT are adopted in the tracking process, which improves the tracking speed and steady-state accuracy of VSCF system. The simulation to verify the effectiveness of the improved algorithm. Compared with the traditional perturb and observe method (P & O), the improved control strategy can track the maximum power of VSCF hydropower system faster when the water flow changes. The results show that it can reduce power oscillation and improve the power generation of the system.

articleTitle: Parameter Estimation Using Improved Adaline Neural Network for Sensorless Control of IPMSM
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th Student Conference on Electric Machines and Systems (SCEMS)
abstract: This paper proposed an improved Adaline neural network method (IANNM) for parameter identification. The proposed method can correctly estimate the dq-axis inductances and stator resistance for the sensorless control of interior permanent magnet synchronous motor (IPMSM). The IANNM adopts the normalized least mean square algorithm with variable step-size (VSS-NLMS), which will be used to update the weight of the network. The IPMSM drives use these accurately estimated parameters to obtain the back electromotive force estimator for the sensorless control. A number of simulation experiments on the proposed IANNM shows that the proposed method has fast and accurate convergence for the estimated parameters compared to the conventional method under dynamic operating conditions.

articleTitle: Multi-parameter identification of permanent magnet synchronous motor based on improved grey wolf optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th Student Conference on Electric Machines and Systems (SCEMS)
abstract: Considering the deficiency of the parameter identification algorithm of permanent magnet synchronous motor(PMSM), such as low identification accuracy and difficulty in identifying multiple parameters at the same time, an improved hybrid grey wolf optimization algorithm (IHGWO) is proposed. Firstly, Cat mapping and reverse learning strategy are used to generate the initial population, which can ensure the diversity of population and improve the convergence. Secondly, an improved sine cosine algorithm (SCA) is used to update the position of the leading wolf, so as to balance the global search and local development ability of IHGWO. Finally, Levy flight strategy is applied to update the optimal predation position of grey wolf group. It can improve the convergence accuracy and the ability to avoid trapping in local optimum. The full rank discrete model of PMSM is established on the d-q frame and the fitness function for parameter identification is given. The corresponding fitness value is obtained by comparing the output value of actual model with that of identification model. The IHGWO algorithm is compared with GWO and other two variants. The simulation and experimental results show that the IHGWO algorithm has the best accuracy, convergence speed and stability for parameter identification of PMSM.

articleTitle: Sensitivity Analysis and Multi-Objective Optimization of a PM-Assisted Synchronous Reluctance Motor with Rectangular Flux-Barriers
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th Student Conference on Electric Machines and Systems (SCEMS)
abstract: In this paper, the permanent magnet (PM) assisted synchronous reluctance (PMAREL) motor with rectangular flux-barriers is studied. Three parametric modeling methods are proposed and compared from the model perspective. Based on the open-source finite element software FEMM, the parametric model of the PMAREL motor is modeled and post-processed through Matlab code. On this basis, a comprehensive sensitivity analysis is carried out according to an initial design. In addition, the developed three parametric modeling methods are also compared by using differential evolution (DE) algorithm to indicate the machine performance difference. The optimization objectives are the average torque and torque ripple. For lowing the torque ripple further, a multi-level optimization is carried out. From the torque ripple point of view, the result of multi-level optimization is way better than global optimization. The effect of inhibition to torque ripple is significant, which can generally be reduced to about 10%. This paper will show the process of the modeling and some useful suggestions can be concluded through multi-objective optimization.

articleTitle: Power Quality Test Data Processing and Comprehensive Analysis Software Design
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th Student Conference on Electric Machines and Systems (SCEMS)
abstract: Electric energy becomes more and more important in our life, so more attention is paid to its quality. Power quality analysis needs to start from harmonic, voltage deviation, frequency and other indicators, the acquisition of these indicators need to conduct power quality test. A large amount of data can be obtained by using a special power quality testing instrument for power quality testing. Aiming at the problem of excessive data processing in power quality, based on the relevant national standards and professional knowledge of power quality, combined with C# programming language, a software for power quality test data processing and comprehensive analysis is developed. The software uses a large amount of power quality data to realize Excel report making, Word report making, report illustration, document search, national standard limit value generation and load assessment in function. Through practical engineering application, it is proved that the software is very convenient for power quality test data processing and comprehensive analysis.

articleTitle: Novel Decoupling Control and Eigenstructure Assignment Strategies for Rigid Active Magnetic Bearing Rotor System
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th Student Conference on Electric Machines and Systems (SCEMS)
abstract: This paper presents a state feedback decoupling control strategy for an active magnetic bearing (AMB) highspeed flywheel rotor system. The most important aspect of the proposed strategy is to design an appropriate state feedback decoupling control law that ensures that the input and output of the controlled system exhibit a one-to-one relationship. Research indicates that the state feedback gain matrix <tex>$K$</tex> already contains sufficient information to enable arbitrary configuration of the eigenvalues of the controlled system, which is usually an 8th order system. Simulations show that this strategy transforms the four coupled radial channels of the AMB high-speed flywheel rotor system into four independent channels. Arbitrary assignment of all the poles on the complex plane makes it easier to design various controllers and achieve both good control performance and good internal stability. The example presented at the end of the article illustrates the practicability of this control strategy.

articleTitle: Analytical calculation of Permanent Magnet Flux Linkage and Winding Inductance of Mover Permanent Magnet Double Salient Reluctance Linear Machines
publicationTitle: 2021 IEEE 4th Student Conference on Electric Machines and Systems (SCEMS)
abstract: Aiming at the nonlinear problem of permanent magnet flux linkage and winding inductance function in the mover permanent magnet double salient reluctance linear machine (MPM-DSRLM), which makes it impossible to establish an accurate mathematical model with a simple algorithm, an analytical method is studied to calculate air gap magnetic field by using the Schwarz-Christoffel (SC) mapping and combine single excitation flux linkage method and integral of the air gap magnetic field to calculate PM flux linkage, winding self-inductance and mutual inductance parameters. In the case of ignoring the saturation of iron core, the PM of MPM - DSRLM is firstly equivalent to line current. Then, the two-dimensional conformal transformation models for PM single excitation and winding current single excitation are established respectively. The air gap magnetic field on the surface of stator tooth is calculated through the SC Toolbox, and it's integrated to get the phase winding flux. Finally, according to the three-phase flux linkage equation, the PM flux linkage, the winding self-inductance and mutual inductance parameters are derived. By comparing the analytical calculation results with the two-dimensional finite element simulation results, it is found that the waveform trend and value of two methods are in good agreement, which makes the mathematical modeling of MPM-DSRLM more simplified and accurate.

Author Keywords: mover permanent magnet double salient reluctance linear machines
